regime_context: The TSX detector shows Big Banks as the leading narrative, with full breadth, high durability, and eligibility, but flagged as crowded. The absolute trend gate provides validated drawdown protection in this market. Rotation is broad but lacks a confirmed single narrative; the macro backdrop is AI/tech and geopolitics driven with an exceptionally high unscheduled surprise share.
emerging_watch: Watch for Base Metals & Copper (XBM.TO) to narrow the rotation margin with Big Banks to below 0.2 AND for Big Banks to become ineligible (trend gate off). If both occur, a leadership handoff could be underway.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks remains the top-ranked narrative with unified participation (breadth=1.0), strong durability (0.69), and trend gate on. While heavy crowding (crowding_z=1.05) warrants sizing caution, the guardrails explicitly warn against fading a dominant theme. The only validated edge—the absolute trend gate—favors staying with the trend, so we lean overweight, respecting the discipline.
evidence: Crowding flag signals concentration, not a fade
theses.dissent: Crowding and a slightly negative short-term return (r10 -0.0147) raise the risk of a sharp deleveraging if sentiment shifts. A concentrated unwind could erase trend gains before the gate reacts.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO (Big Banks ETF) underperforms the TSX Composite by 5% on a cumulative basis over any 10-day window before 2026-08-28.

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Technology is low-ranked (14th) and ineligible, indicating the absolute trend gate has switched off. Given the gate’s validated role in reducing drawdowns, we lean avoid as a risk-control measure—not a return forecast. The theme may still rally on macro AI surprises, but the trend-off status suggests elevated downside volatility.
evidence: Durability bar 0.69 but eligibility false—trend metric negative
theses.dissent: The dominant macro narrative is AI/tech, and an unscheduled positive tech shock could spark a sharp reversal in Canadian technology stocks. The ineligibility may prove transient.

falsifier.text: XIT.TO (Technology ETF) becomes eligible and outperforms the TSX by 3% over any 10-day window before 2026-08-28.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
